ops.title: Rust hot-path architecture: approved plan
ops.body:
Approved 2026-07-20 (plan-rust-arch agent; team-lead approved via ExitPlanMode). Full plan: /Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-05/plans/continue-the-performance-pass-rippling-lobster-agent-aplan-rust-arch-432627e6f2581df4.md

Decisions locked:
- Phase A: Rust thin client `hook` as a second PyPI dist `capt-hook-bin` (maturin bindings="bin"); main capt-hook wheel stays hatchling, depends on capt-hook-bin, drops its `hook` console script; capt_hook_client/ deleted (key.py relocates to captain_hook/daemon/). Plugin consumers: sh launcher + detached `uv venv`+`uv pip install capt-hook==<plugin.json ver>` bootstrap into $XDG_CACHE_HOME/captain-hook/env/<ver> — no network ever on the hot path.
- Split-brain fixes: strike ledger (2 post-send failures/60s -> verified SIGTERM + cold + fresh spawn) and per-connect meta.json version check -> drain on env-version mismatch.
- Ack mode (fire-and-forget): all --async requests + SessionEnd both lanes; grounded in app.py:41-57 (Claude Code never awaits async hook stdout). Sync Stop/SessionStart always await. posttooluse_async parity case redefined as documented edge #4.
- Protocol v2: binary payload frame (payload_len header + raw bytes — serde_json cannot carry the lone surrogates surrogateescape produces), client-extracted session_id, ack, deadline_ms, real client.version. Daemon accepts {1,2}.
- Phase B: Rust supervisor + Python worker process pool (embedded pyo3 CPython REJECTED: no crash isolation, GIL serialization). request_scope/env-binding parity machinery moves into worker.py untouched; server.py deleted; worker build-watchdog exits with reserved code, supervisor respawns under a persistent socket (zero-downtime wheel upgrades).
- Phase C deferred, profiling-gated. Never port: Fingerprint/build_id (repr-based digests), dispatch semantics, llm_*/NLP/review.
- No dual-execution fallbacks or rust-vs-python toggle env vars (cc-notes 76ef769 ban).

Open decisions (recommended defaults stand unless the user overrides): (1) ack scope = all async + SessionEnd, pending a live-session probe in spike A0; (2) distribution = capt-hook-bin dist + launcher (not binaries-in-plugin-repo); (3) fleet flip = one release after dogfood soak.
